official_archive.primary_paper_data_model_statement: Ogden et al. (2015), doi:10.1002/2015WR017126, identifies doi:10.15786/M2WC70 as the code/data source for the eight-month finite-water-content test.

alternative_source_reconciliation.hydpy_statement: HydPy documentation reports that Fred L. Ogden and Cary A. Talbot provided original C source used to check the GARTO implementation.
alternative_source_reconciliation.reason: GARTO uses a different reduced wetting-front representation and cannot establish the M2WC70 finite-water-content natural surface-front/groundwater-front state conversion by semantic identity.
